pages.title: flavor_immersed_daily_argo-common.toml
pages.text: This is the main config. It is a COMMON config, read on the server side — editing it on a client changes nothing.$(br2)The mod actually reads the options listed on the following pages; the rest are leftovers from the NeoForge template.

pages.title: Options that matter
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)giveGuideBookOnFirstJoin$() (default true): give each player one Nanshan Tutorial Scroll the first time they join. Each player receives it once.$(br)$(li)$(bold)giveFishingHandbookOnFirstJoin$() (default true): give each player one Catch Handbook the first time they join, also once per player. Both use advancement completion saved in the world, so rejoining never hands out a second copy.$(br)$(li)$(bold)mouseChunkLimit$() (default 2, range 1~64): how many field mice may exist in one chunk. Once reached, no more spawn there.$(br)$(li)$(bold)warnMissingParentMod$() (default true): remind players on login when the parent mod is missing.

pages.title: Natural spawning switches
pages.text: Four options decide whether this mod's animals appear on their own. All are $(bold)false$() by default — the intended source is spawn eggs bought online.$(br)$(li)$(bold)mouseNaturalSpawning$(): whether field mice spawn near mature crops.$(br)$(li)$(bold)landAnimalNaturalSpawning$(): whether poultry and livestock (duck, goose, quail, pigeon, turkey, bullfrog, bamboo rat) spawn on land.$(br)$(li)$(bold)freshwaterNaturalSpawning$(): whether freshwater animals spawn in non-ocean water.$(br)$(li)$(bold)saltwaterNaturalSpawning$(): whether saltwater animals spawn in ocean biomes.$(br2)These only gate natural spawning. Animals from spawn eggs, commands or fishing nets are unaffected; the mouse command override is covered under Admin Commands.

pages.title: Husbandry values
pages.text: These only affect the $(bold)server-side$() animal stats; ranges and defaults are documented in the config file:$(br2)$(li)$(bold)animalDecayAmount$() (default 1, 0~10): how much satiety / thirst / cleanliness each drops every 30 seconds. 0 disables decay, and animals then stop producing manure.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalRestoreAmount$() (default 1, 0~10): how much is restored every 5 seconds near water, while swimming or in rain.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalFeedSatiety$() / $(bold)animalFeedMood$() (default 3 / 1): gained per hand-feed.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalWeightStepRatio$() (default 0.02): share of the standard weight gained or lost per step.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalPoopChance$() (default 0.25, 0~1): manure chance each settlement when satiety is consumed.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalFlyBiteCleanLoss$() (default 5): extra cleanliness lost per settlement while fly-bitten.$(br)$(li)$(bold)petExcretion$() (default false): whether cats and dogs also excrete; livestock and poultry always do.

pages.title: Trough values
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)troughNeedThreshold$() (default 5, 0~9): a trough only attracts animals whose satiety or thirst is $(bold)at or below$() this value.$(br)$(li)$(bold)troughRestoreAmount$() (default 5, 1~10): restored per bite at the trough.$(br)$(li)$(bold)troughFeedInterval$() (default 20, 1~1200): ticks between bites in one visit.$(br2)The trough keeps refilling the current item (feed or water) until it reaches 10 before letting the animal go, so threshold and restore amount only change the pace, not the final result.

pages.title: Feed whitelist and overrides
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)extraFeedAnimals$(): extra animal entity ids pulled into the husbandry system, empty by default. Listed animals are treated as eating grain/vegetable feed, and may be vanilla or modded $(thing)Animal$() subclasses; unknown mod ids are skipped instead of crashing.$(br)$(li)$(bold)animalFeedOverrides$(): one $(thing)entityId=itemId,itemId$() per line. An explicit mapping $(bold)overrides$() the built-in lists and vanilla $(thing)isFood$()$(); the last line for an entity wins, and an empty right side disables feed for that animal.$(br2)Mappings apply to all three paths: hand-feeding, held-item attraction and the trough. Reload the world after editing so loaded animals rebuild their attraction goals.

pages.title: Safe to ignore
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)logDirtBlock$(), $(thing)magicNumber$(), $(thing)magicNumberIntroduction$() and $(thing)items$() come from the NeoForge example project. The mod $(bold)never reads$() them; any value is harmless.$(br2)They are kept only to keep the config layout stable, so leaving the defaults is fine.
